D/ [I]MP C VICT[ORINVS P F AVG] ; R/ [VIRT]VS A[VG]

An incomplete copper alloy radiate of Victorinus AD 269-271), reverse type soldier with spear and shield - VIRTVS AVG. Reece Period: 13. Obverse description: Bust of Victorinus, radiate, draped, right. Obverse inscription: [I]MP C VICT[ORINVS P F AVG]. Reverse description: Hercules walking left with lion skin over arm holding club. Reverse inscription: [VIRT]VS A[VG]. Die axis measurement: 12…
